{
  "verdict": "request",
  "cause": "MAX_TOKENS_TINY",
  "fix": {"action": "raise_max_tokens", "target": "max_new_tokens", "value": 256},
  "rationale": "The script calls model.generate() with no max_new_tokens, so transformers falls back to its default of 20 new tokens. The printed reply is exactly ~20 tokens long and ends mid-sentence at 'The', which is truncation at the token budget, not an EOS stop (the configured eos ids 151645/151643 are correct for this model and would have ended after a completed turn). The run-to-run wording changes come from do_sample=true in generation_config.json and are expected, not a fault. Passing max_new_tokens=256 (or higher) to generate() lets the model finish the answer."
}
